name: Jitters' Completed Journal
summary: In Duskwood, Jitters gives up his completed journal and hopes it will clear his name. He fears Sven Yorgen's vengeance after fleeing the massacre at Sven's farm.

sections.title: A Coward's Confession
sections.body: Jitters fled Sven's farm when the attack began, leaving his half-finished diary in the ruins. In the completed journal, he recounts how mysterious dark riders slaughtered Sven's family. For weeks, its pages were his only comfort while he hid in Duskwood. Now he gives the finished volume willingly, hoping the truth will spare him Sven's fury.

sections.title: Unraveling the Darkness
sections.body: The journal leads Sven to speak of black-cloaked riders he saw talking with the wizard Morbent Fel at the Forlorn Rowe. Sven sends the manuscript north with travelers bound for the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind. There, Bishop Farthing reads Jitters' account to learn of Duskwood's vile taint. Its revelations help him craft a holy weapon that can pierce Fel's dark wards.

faq.q: Why did Jitters give up his journal?
faq.answer: Jitters fled Sven's farm during the attack and left an unfinished journal behind. He gives adventurers the completed version to bring to Sven, hoping the full truth will clear his name and protect him from Sven's anger.

faq.q: What does the journal reveal about Sven's farm?
faq.answer: Jitters' completed journal gives his eyewitness account of the tragedy at Sven Yorgen's farm, filling in what his unfinished diary left out.

faq.q: Who is Morbent Fel and how is he connected to the journal?
faq.answer: Morbent Fel is a necromancer at the Forlorn Rowe. The journal leads Sven to share that he has seen the black-cloaked riders speaking with Fel.

faq.q: Why is the journal taken to Stormwind?
faq.answer: Sven sends the journal to Bishop Farthing at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind. Farthing reads it to understand Duskwood's taint and help prepare a holy weapon that can pierce Morbent Fel's magical wards.

angles.text: As a priest, you bring the journal to Bishop Farthing at the Cathedral of Light and serve the cleansing of unholy defilement through holy relics.
As an Alliance member, you see how far Duskwood has fallen into peril while Stormwind's leaders focus elsewhere.
